Opened the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" in Grafana via the top-nav "Search or jump to…" dialog (it appeared under Recent dashboards) and confirmed it is loaded in read-only view mode (no edits made). The dashboard contains exactly 3 panels, in this order: 1) "Request rate", 2) "Error count" (showing 40.0 errors), 3) "Latency by endpoint" (a table with columns Time, A, Min, Max, Info, State). This was verified both by the panel-header elements (data-testid "Panel header Request rate" / "Error count" / "Latency by endpoint") and by a full accessibility snapshot of the dashboard main area, which shows only those three region/heading pairs — no collapsed rows or additional panels.

steps.summary: Opened the dashboard settings (entered edit mode to reach the gear/'Settings' → 'Dashboard settings' control, since view mode has no gear in this build), typed "bench" into the Tags field of General settings and pressed Enter, which produced a remove-able "bench" tag chip. Clicked "Save dashboard", and Grafana confirmed the save with its "Dashboard saved" alert. I then reloaded the settings page (?editview=settings), where the Tags field contained exactly one tag, "bench", so the change persisted. Edit mode was exited afterwards, leaving the dashboard in normal read view with both panels intact.
